ai_summary: Prataap Snacks Limited has strategically expanded its Board of Directors by appointing two additional members, subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Jitendra Nayyar joins as an Independent Non-Executive Director, bringing over 30 years of diverse finance leadership experience across multiple industries, enhancing external oversight. Concurrently, Mr. Sumit Sharma, the company's long-standing CFO and instrumental in its growth, has been promoted to Executive Director, leveraging deep internal expertise and ensuring continuity. This move strengthens the board with a balanced mix of external strategic guidance and internal operational knowledge, with no immediate red flags identified.
